newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: World edible/soap fats, oils output seen up.
newsitem.headline: World edible/soap fats, oils output seen up.

text.p: Global production of edible/soap fats and oils in 1996/97 is expected to rise 1.5 percent to 97 million tonnes, a U.N. official said at a conference on Thursday.
Total output of the world's seven major oilseeds is, meanwhile, expected to grow only one percent to 263 million tonnes, M. Maftei, a commodities specialist with the United Nations, said.

Maftei, speaking at the Vegoils, Oilseeds & Meals '97 conference in Kuala Lumpur, said soybean was expected to make up 21 percent or the largest portion of the 97 million tonnes of oils and fats output projected for 1996/97.
